scientific_integrity: The universal statements follow from the obstruction proof, symbolic transfer identity and coefficient extraction; finite checker runs are supporting tests, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The deterministic two-neighbor threshold applies to a fixed, undirected, unlabeled-edge but labeled-vertex width-two ladder only.
No extension to weighted edges, wider strips, fractional or heterogeneous thresholds, or empirical adoption is established.

title: Exact cascade reliability and sharp seed counts on a two-rail social network
